requirements.text: Any lamp shall be permitted to be installed on movable components, provided that the conditions specified in paragraphs 5.18, 5.19 and 5.20 are fulfilled.
requirements.test_case: Check the vehicle installation drawings to see whether the device is on a movable component.

requirements.text: Rear position lamps, rear direction-indicators and rear retro-reflectors, triangular as well as non-triangular, shall be permitted to be installed on movable components only if the condition in paragraph 5.18.1 is fulfilled.
requirements.test_case: Check the installation drawings for mounting on movable components.

requirements.text: At all fixed positions of the movable components, the rear position lamps, rear direction-indicators and rear retro-reflectors on the movable components shall meet all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for those lamps.
requirements.test_case: Check position, visibility, colour and photometry at all fixed positions of the movable component.

requirements.text: In the case where the functions referred to in paragraph 5.18. are obtained by an assembly of two lamps marked "D" (see paragraph 2.4.11.1.), only one of the lamps shall meet the position, geometric visibility and photometric requirements for those lamps at all fixed positions of the movable components.
requirements.test_case: Check the markings and the installation drawings.

requirements.text: Where additional lamps for the functions of paragraph 5.18. are fitted and are switched ON when the movable component is in any fixed open position, these additional lamps shall satisfy all the position, geometric visibility and photometric requirements applicable to the lamps installed on the movable component.
requirements.test_case: Check whether additional lamps exist and verify their position, visibility and photometry.

requirements.text: When the movable components are in a position other than a "normal position of use", the devices installed on them shall not cause undue discomfort to road users.
requirements.test_case: With the component in non-normal positions, check that the devices cause no undue discomfort.

requirements.text: When a lamp is installed on a movable component and the movable component is in the "normal position(s) of use", the lamp shall always return to the position(s) specified by the manufacturer in accordance with this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Check that the lamp returns to the manufacturer-specified position after moving the component.

requirements.text: The apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of front and rear position lamps, front and rear direction-indicator lamps and retro-reflectors shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent by any movable component, with or without a light-signalling device installed on it, in any fixed position different from the "normal position of use".
requirements.test_case: Check that no more than 50 percent of the apparent surface is hidden in any fixed position of a movable component.

requirements.text: If the requirement of paragraph 5.21. is not practicable, additional lamps satisfying all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for the above indicated lamps shall be switched ON when the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of these lamps is more than 50 per cent hidden by the movable component.
requirements.test_case: Check that additional compliant lamps switch ON when more than 50 percent of the surface is hidden.

requirements.text: If the requirement of paragraph 5.21. is not practicable, a notice in the vehicle shall inform the user that in certain position(s) of the movable components other road users shall be warned of the presence of the vehicle on the road, for example by means of a warning triangle or other devices according to national requirements for use on the road, this paragraph not applying to retro-reflectors.
requirements.test_case: Check vehicle installation for movable components hiding the lamps and the user notice in the manual.

requirements.text: Lamps approved with light source(s) according to UN Regulation No. 37, except when such light sources are used as non-replaceable light source(s) as defined in paragraph 2.9.1.2., shall be fitted in a vehicle in such a way that the light source can be correctly replaced without the need for expert assistance and without the need for special tools, other than those provided with the vehicle by the manufacturer.
requirements.test_case: Check the light source type and replace it without special tools.

requirements.text: The vehicle manufacturer shall provide with the vehicle a detailed description of the procedure for replacement of light sources of lamps approved according to UN Regulation No. 37, except when such light sources are used as non-replaceable light source(s) as defined in paragraph 2.9.1.2.
requirements.test_case: Check the vehicle documentation for a light source replacement procedure.

requirements.text: Where a light source module includes a holder for an approved replaceable light source according to Regulation No. 37, this light source shall be replaceable as required in paragraph 5.23.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the module design for a replaceable light source holder.

requirements.text: Any temporary fail-safe replacement of the light-signalling function of a rear position lamp shall be permitted, provided that the replacement function in case of a failure is similar in colour, main intensity and position to the function that has ceased to operate and provided that the replacement device remains operational in its original safety function.
requirements.test_case: Check the design documents for a fail-safe replacement function and verify its colour, intensity and position.

requirements.text: During replacement of the light-signalling function of a rear position lamp, a tell-tale on the dashboard (paragraph 2.3.5. of this Regulation) shall indicate occurrence of a temporary replacement and need for repair.
requirements.test_case: Simulate a failure and check that the dashboard tell-tale indicates the replacement.

requirements.text: In the entire intensity range, the specific prescribed ratio between the luminous intensities of two lamps, if applicable, shall be maintained throughout variation transitions.
requirements.test_case: Measure the intensity ratio across the whole variation range.

requirements.text: Rear direction indicator lamps of category 2b, rear position lamps of category R2 and stop lamps of category S2 with variable luminous intensity control, which respond simultaneously to one or more of the conditions listed in paragraphs 5.26.1. and 5.26.2., shall be permitted.
requirements.test_case: Check the design documents for variable intensity control and its trigger conditions.

requirements.text: The intensity of all the lamps mentioned in paragraph 5.26., when combined, grouped or reciprocally incorporated, shall vary all together in the same manner and in a similar proportion.
requirements.test_case: Vary the intensity and check that the combined lamps vary together proportionally.

requirements.text: Rear direction indicator lamps of category 2b and rear position lamps shall be permitted to increase or decrease the luminous intensity, within the limits prescribed in the pertinent UN Regulations, in relation to the following conditions: ambient lighting, fog, snowfall, rain, spray, dust clouds, and contamination of the light emitting surface.
requirements.test_case: Check the control logic and verify intensity stays within the limits of the device regulation.

requirements.text: Independently from the environmental conditions in paragraph 5.26.1, rear direction indicator lamps of category 2b and rear position lamps shall be permitted to decrease the luminous intensity, within the limits prescribed in the pertinent UN Regulations, as long as the vehicle speed is equal or less than 20 km/h or the distance to the following vehicle is equal or less than 20 m.
requirements.test_case: Check the dimming conditions at speeds of 20 km/h or below and verify intensity limits.

requirements.text: Rear direction indicator lamps of category 2b and rear position lamps shall be permitted to keep an intensity decrease already activated active as long as the vehicle speed is equal or less than 50 km/h.
requirements.test_case: Check the control logic for a dimming hold up to 50 km/h.

requirements.text: Stop lamps of category S4 and rear fog lamps of category F2 shall be permitted to produce variable luminous intensity, based on the conditions listed in paragraphs 5.26.1. and 5.26.2., independently from the other lamps.
requirements.test_case: Check the stop lamp category and whether intensity control is implemented.

requirements.text: Lamps with variable luminous intensity under paragraphs 5.26.1 to 5.26.3 shall show no sharp variation of intensity during transition.
requirements.test_case: Record intensity during transitions and check for no sharp variation.

requirements.text: The variable luminous intensity functions described in paragraphs 5.26.1 to 5.26.3 shall be permitted to be set by the driver to static luminous intensities.
requirements.test_case: Check the design for a driver-selectable static intensity.

requirements.text: For vehicles of M and N categories, the applicant shall demonstrate to the Technical Service responsible for type approval testing that the electric power supply conditions for the devices indicated in 2.5.1., 2.5.2., 2.5.4., 2.5.6. and 2.5.7. above comply, when the electrical system of the vehicle is in a constant voltage operating condition, representative for the relevant category of powered vehicle as specified by the applicant, with the following provisions.
requirements.test_case: Measure the voltage at the lamp terminals under constant-voltage operating conditions.

requirements.text: The voltage supplied at the terminals of devices which, according to their type approval documentation, have been tested by the application of a special power supply/electronic light source control gear, or in a secondary operating mode or at a voltage requested by the applicant, shall not exceed the voltage specified for the relevant devices or functions as they have been approved.
requirements.test_case: Check the approval documents and measure the terminal voltage against the approved value.

requirements.text: In all cases of electric power supply conditions not covered by paragraph 5.27.1, the voltage at the terminals of the device(s) or function(s) shall not exceed 6.75 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.5 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28 V (24 Volt-Systems) by more than 3 per cent.
requirements.test_case: Measure that the terminal voltage does not exceed 13.5 V (12 V system) or 28 V (24 V system) by more than 3%.

requirements.text: The lamp shall have no obstacle on the inside of the angles of geometric visibility to the propagation of light from any part of the apparent surface of the lamp observed from infinity; however, no account is taken of obstacles, if they were already presented when the lamp was type-approved.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the installed lamp for obstacles within the geometric visibility angles.

requirements.text: If, when the lamp is installed, any part of the apparent surface of the lamp is hidden by any further parts of the vehicle, the applicant shall furnish proof that the part of the lamp not hidden by obstacles still conforms to the photometric values prescribed for the approval of the device.
requirements.test_case: Check for hidden surface and provide photometric proof for the visible part.

requirements.text: When the lamp is at less than 750 mm above the ground measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1., the photometric field of measurements of the installed optical unit shall be permitted to be reduced to 5º below the horizontal.
requirements.test_case: Measure the mounting height and the photometric field.

requirements.text: When the lamp is at less than 750 mm above the ground measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1., the vertical angle of geometric visibility below the horizontal shall be permitted to be reduced to 5º.
requirements.test_case: Measure the mounting height and check the visibility angle.

requirements.text: In the case of an interdependent lamp system, the geometric visibility requirements shall be fulfilled when all its interdependent lamps are operated together.
requirements.test_case: Check whether the lamps are marked Y and verify visibility with all operated together.

requirements.text: All lamps (devices) shall, where applicable, be type approved according to the corresponding device Regulations as specified in the relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 6 of this Regulation when installed on a vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Check the approval marks and certificates for each device.

requirements.text: A light-signalling lamp incorporating a manufacturer logo shall be type approved according to the requirements of the UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Check for a logo and the UN R148 approval.

requirements.text: Lamps installed on a vehicle which is approved according to this Regulation and approved for one or more replaceable light source categories according to Regulations Nos. 37, 99 or 128 shall be fitted with light sources approved according to these light source categories only; this requirement does not concern light source modules, LED modules and non-replaceable light sources, except for when they are required to be approved by the applicable Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Check that any replaceable light source belongs to an approved category.

requirements.text: The use of lamps approved for and equipped with LED substitute light source(s) shall be permitted exclusively in the case where the statement indicated in paragraph 3.2.8. is present and positive.
requirements.test_case: Check whether LED substitute light sources are used and the statement in 3.2.8.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp devices shall be type-approved according to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 23, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Check the approval marking and certificate to UN R23 or R148.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be positioned in height not less than 250 mm and not more than 1,200 mm above the ground; for category N2G, N3G, M2G, M3G (off-road) vehicles the maximum height may be increased to 1,400 mm.
requirements.test_case: Measure the height of the lamp's illuminating surface above ground on the vehicle.

requirements.text: If installed, the two optional devices mentioned in paragraph 6.4.2.2. shall be permitted to be fitted on the side of the vehicle, provided that the requirements of paragraphs 6.4.5.2. and 6.4.6.2. below are fulfilled.
requirements.test_case: Check the vehicle specification for optional side reversing lamps; if fitted, verify the 6.4.5.2 and 6.4.6.2 requirements.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be positioned in length at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the installation and measure that the lamp sits at the rear of the vehicle in length.

requirements.text: Reversing lamp devices installed at the rear of the vehicle shall have a geometric visibility defined by angle α = 15° upwards and 5° downwards, as specified in paragraph 2.10.7.
requirements.test_case: Check geometric visibility angles with the lamp installed.

requirements.text: Reversing lamp devices installed at the rear of the vehicle shall have a geometric visibility defined by angle β = 45° to right and to left if there is only one device, and 45° outwards and 30° inwards if there are two, as specified in paragraph 2.10.7.
requirements.test_case: Check horizontal geometric visibility angles with the lamp installed.

requirements.text: The electrical connections of the reversing lamp shall be such that the lamp can be switched ON only if the reverse gear is engaged and if the device which controls the starting and stopping of the propulsion system is in such a position that operation of the propulsion system is possible.
requirements.test_case: Check the wiring diagram and test that the lamp lights only with reverse engaged and propulsion enabled.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall not switch ON or remain ON if either the reverse gear is not engaged or the device which controls the starting and stopping of the propulsion system is not in such a position that operation of the propulsion system is possible.
requirements.test_case: Functional test: with reverse not engaged, or with propulsion disabled, confirm the lamp is off, and that it switches off when either condition is removed.

requirements.text: A tell-tale indicating failure shall be mandatory if required by the component regulation.
requirements.test_case: Check the component regulation for a tell-tale requirement and, if required, verify the tell-tale works.

requirements.text: The stop lamp devices shall be type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Check the approval marking/certificate to UN R7 (02+) or R148 (00+).

requirements.text: On M1 and N1 category vehicles, the S1 or S2 category stop lamp device whose apparent surface points in the direction of the reference axis farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall be not more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Measure distance from the apparent surface's outermost point to the vehicle's extreme outer edge (≤400 mm).

requirements.text: If the optional S1 or S2 category stop lamps are installed, they shall be positioned at a height compatible with the requirements of the width and the symmetry of the lamps.
requirements.test_case: Check whether optional lamps are fitted; if so verify height compatible with width and symmetry.

requirements.text: If the optional S1 or S2 category stop lamps are installed, they shall be positioned at a vertical distance as large as the shape of the bodywork makes it possible, but not less than 600 mm above the mandatory lamps.
requirements.test_case: If optional lamps fitted, measure vertical spacing ≥600 mm above mandatory lamps.

requirements.text: S1 or S2 category stop lamp devices shall be positioned above the ground not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and if the optional lamps are not installed).
requirements.test_case: Measure height above ground of the lamp (350–1500 mm) on the vehicle.

requirements.text: S1 or S2 category stop lamp devices shall be positioned at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the vehicle installation to confirm the stop lamp is at the rear.

requirements.text: S1 or S2 category stop lamp devices shall be geometrically visible 15° above and 15° below the horizontal; however, where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°, and where an optional lamp is mounted above 2,100 mm the upward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Verify ±15° vertical visibility (reduced values where permitted) on the installed lamp.

requirements.text: S1 or S2 category stop lamp devices shall be geometrically visible within 45° to the left and to the right of the longitudinal axis of the vehicle; however, for stop lamps of categories S1 and S2 mounted below 750 mm, the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
requirements.test_case: Verify geometric visibility angles (45° outward/inward) on the installed lamp by drawing/measurement.

requirements.text: Stop lamp devices shall be oriented towards the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect that the lamp's reference axis points rearward.

requirements.text: All stop lamps shall be switched ON simultaneously when the braking system provides the relevant signal defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H.
requirements.test_case: Actuate service brake and verify all stop lamps light simultaneously.

requirements.text: A tell-tale indicating failure of the stop lamps shall be provided if required by the component regulation.
requirements.test_case: Check UN R7/R148 requirements for a failure tell-tale and verify on the vehicle if required.

requirements.text: The rear position lamps shall be two, type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Check the approval marking and certificate against UN R7 02 series or later, or UN R148 00 series or later.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle; this condition shall not apply to the optional rear lamps.
requirements.test_case: Measure the distance from the outermost point of the apparent surface to the vehicle's extreme outer edge on the vehicle.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp height above the ground shall be not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm, or 2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and the optional lamps are not installed.
requirements.test_case: Measure the height above ground of the apparent surface at the unladen vehicle condition.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall be positioned at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the vehicle to verify the lamp is mounted at the rear.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall have a horizontal angle of 45° inwards and 80° outwards, except that where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm, the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
requirements.test_case: Check horizontal visibility angles (45° inwards, 80° outwards) per the R48 visibility check.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall have a vertical angle of 15° above and below the horizontal, except that where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°, and where an optional lamp is mounted above 2,100 mm the upward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Check vertical visibility angles (15° above and below horizontal) with the exceptions for mounting height.

requirements.text: If a rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with a direction-indicator, the electrical connection of the rear position lamp on the relevant side of the vehicle or the reciprocally incorporated part of it shall be permitted to be such that it is switched OFF during the entire time (both ON and OFF cycle) of operation of the direction-indicator lamp.
requirements.test_case: Check the design and wiring to see whether the position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with a direction-indicator.

requirements.text: The electrical connection of the rear position lamp shall be in accordance with paragraph 5.11.
requirements.test_case: Check the wiring against paragraph 5.11 and verify the lamp switches on with the front position lamps.

requirements.text: A closed-circuit tell-tale for the rear position lamps shall be provided as mandatory, combined with that of the front position lamps; this requirement does not apply when daytime running lamps are switched ON.
requirements.test_case: Check for the tell-tale at the driver's position, activated with the position lamps.

requirements.text: A tell-tale indicating failure of the rear position lamps shall be mandatory if required by the component Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Check whether the applicable component Regulation requires a failure tell-tale and, if so, verify it.

requirements.text: Additional retro-reflecting devices and materials (including two retro-reflectors not complying with paragraph 6.14.4. below) shall be permitted, provided they do not impair the effectiveness of the mandatory lighting and light-signalling devices.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the vehicle for additional retro-reflecting devices and verify they do not impair the mandatory lamps' effectiveness.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflectors shall be two in number, type-approved according to the requirements concerning Class IA or IB retro-reflectors in the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 3, or in the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 150.
requirements.test_case: Check the retro-reflector's UN R3 (Class IA/IB) or UN R150 approval marking and certificate; confirm there are two.

requirements.text: That point on the illuminating surface of the rear retro-reflector which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Measure the distance from the outermost point of the illuminating surface to the vehicle's extreme outer edge (max 400 mm).

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall be positioned above the ground not less than 250 mm nor more than 900 mm (not more than 1,200 mm if grouped with any rear lamp(s), 1,500 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 900 mm or 1200 mm respectively).
requirements.test_case: Measure the height of the reflector's lowest and highest points above the ground at the unladen reference condition (250-900 mm, or up to 1,200 mm if grouped with rear lamps).

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall be positioned at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the vehicle and drawings to confirm the retro-reflector is mounted at the rear.

requirements.text: The geometric visibility of the rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall have a horizontal angle of 30° inwards and outwards.
requirements.test_case: Check on the vehicle or drawings that the visible area is unobstructed within 30° inwards and outwards.

requirements.text: The geometric visibility of the rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall have a vertical angle of 10° above and below horizontal; however, where a retro-reflector is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward angle of 10° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Check on the vehicle or drawings that the visible area is unobstructed within the 10° upward and 10° (or 5°) downward angles.

requirements.text: The emergency stop signal shall be given by the simultaneous operation of all the stop or direction-indicator lamps fitted as described in paragraph 6.23.7.
requirements.test_case: Check the vehicle wiring and operation: on emergency stop signal activation, all stop lamps operate simultaneously.
